_comment: Azure-primary Stado deployment. Install at ~/.stado/config.json (or point $STADO_CONFIG at it). Replace every <placeholder> before use. Provider preference, explicit fences and both storage locators live only in this file.
_providers_comment: GCP is fenced while billing is disabled. AWS is fenced until its network and AMI settings are provisioned; remove a provider from providers_disabled only when doctor can authenticate and schedule it.

backup._comment: Cross-provider replica. The coordinator refreshes it after every dispatch tick; product object writes mirror synchronously. Promotion is manual and fenced.

azure._network_comment: The provider does NOT create networking. vnet and nsg must already exist per region, named <vnet>-<location> and <nsg>-<location> (providers/azure/network.rs). The subnet is a child of the region vnet so it carries no suffix.
azure._image_comment: image_urn is omitted so the built-in default applies: the microsoft-dsvm ubuntu-hpc image, which ships the NVIDIA driver and CUDA preinstalled. Override here only to pin a different publisher:offer:sku:version.

dashboard._comment: Keep the Rust listener loopback-only. Caddy terminates TLS and forwards the dedicated software release route plus authenticated product/control routes.

secrets._comment: Coordinator/dashboard read-only grant for central service items. Object routes read only stado-object-api/token, machine submit/status/cancel reads only stado-machine-api/token, and managed-service status/restart reads only stado-service-api/token. Every path fails closed; no application token belongs in env or this file.

agent._comment: Dedicated Azure VM grant. Its visible items must equal this allowlist exactly. The grant is handed to the VM only through encrypted Azure protectedSettings, never customData. Jobs may resolve only the exact item#field entries below; stado-aws remains trusted-agent infrastructure and is deliberately absent from secret_fields.

release._comment: Required binary channel for Rust self-update and Azure VM bootstrap. Publish the release layout into this private Azure container; Stado authenticates with the coordinator or VM managed identity. There is no built-in cloud release origin.

alerts._comment: Empty disables the isolated optional GCP Pub/Sub channel. Configure a provider-neutral alert sink separately.
